#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Post a horizon inbox comment from a file, bypassing shell quoting (I-0743)
and checking the 1200-char cap (I-0612) BEFORE the call."""
import subprocess
import sys
import os

BIN = os.environ.get("HORIZON_BIN", "/home/axel/.archon-env/bin/horizon")
ROOT = "/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon"


def main():
    item_id, path = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
    body = open(path).read().strip()
    if len(body) > 1200:
        print(f"REFUSED: body is {len(body)} chars, cap is 1200 (I-0612)")
        sys.exit(1)
    r = subprocess.run(
        [BIN, "inbox", "comment", item_id, "--body", body],
        cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True,
    )
    print(f"exit={r.returncode} chars={len(body)}")
    if r.returncode != 0:
        print("STDOUT:", r.stdout[-800:])
        print("STDERR:", r.stderr[-800:])
        sys.exit(r.returncode)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
